system:
You choose which clips get posted as ads for a vertical drama app.

You will see two clips taken from the same show, written out as everything that
happens in them. You have never seen the show. Pick the ONE you would post to
stop a scrolling viewer and make them open the app.

Judge only on: does something arresting happen immediately, does it make sense
without context, and does it stop at a moment that leaves you needing more.
Ignore length. Ignore which one you were shown first.

You must choose. Reply with JSON only:
{
  "choice": 1 or 2,
  "reason": "<one sentence>",
  "confidence": "high" | "low"
}
prompt:
CLIP 1:
[action] Lord Sterling clutches his gold-headed walking cane tightly, his jaw clenching as tension spreads through the church.
BLOND NOBLEMAN: "You have all been deceived!"
ALEXANDER: "Then let the Crown decide."
[action] Alexander brings forth the dossier stamped "WAR OFFICE - TOP SECRET" with the royal crest.
ALEXANDER: "These were delivered to me under the seal of the Crown."
ALEXANDER: "Read the first."
[action] The Crown Official receives the dossier solemnly with both hands.
[sfx] Crisp sound of parchment turning.
CROWN OFFICIAL: "Military Intelligence Report, Iberian front, three years ago."
CROWN OFFICIAL: "Duke Alexander Ashburn's unit was ambushed after his location was compromised."

-----

CLIP 2:
ALEXANDER: "You sold my men to the enemy."
BLOND NOBLEMAN: "I didn't!"
ALEXANDER: "And when you believed I was dead..."
ALEXANDER: "You took my title."
[sfx] Brittle snap of breaking sealing wax.
CROWN OFFICIAL: "Official death confirmation was filed three months after the ambush."
CROWN OFFICIAL: "Duke Alexander Ashburn was declared dead."
CROWN OFFICIAL: "His estate and title were subsequently transferred under false authority."

Which would you post?
response_text: {"choice":2,"reason":"It opens with a betrayal accusation and ends on a conspiratorial revelation that his title was taken under false authority, creating an immediate hook.","confidence":"high"}

message.reasoning: We need to pick which clip is more arresting, makes sense without context, ends on a hook. Clip 1: tension, secret dossier, war ambush. Ends with "Duke Alexander Ashburn's unit was ambushed after his location was compromised." That's a statement, not a cliffhanger. Clip 2: accusation, betrayal, title taken, sealing wax snap, death confirmation filed, title transferred under false authority. Ends with "under false authority." That's a hook, suggests conspiracy. More dramatic. So choose Clip 2. Provide JSON.
